User Story: As a listener I want to see my subscribed podcasts so I can pick something to play
Expected Behaviour: Subscribed podcasts render in list/grid per layout setting; empty library shows icon + localized message
Edge Cases: Empty library; async load spinner; layout change reloads

User Story: As a listener I want to follow/unfollow a podcast
Expected Behaviour: Subscribe adds podcast to library; unsubscribe removes it and its episodes
Notes: No direct unit test for subscribe flow

User Story: As a listener I want to mark a whole podcast played
Expected Behaviour: markAllPlayed sets every unplayed episode played + position 0 and persists
Edge Cases: All-already-played is a no-op; only unplayed episodes saved

User Story: As a listener I want to browse trending podcasts
Expected Behaviour: Charts load by genre/country; warm-load on startup; cache skips spinner on revisit
Edge Cases: Loading->populated lifecycle; 30-min cache; genre change refetches
Notes: Cache + lifecycle covered; UI rendering still manual

User Story: As a listener I want to search podcasts by term
Expected Behaviour: Results paginate; loading/error/empty states render
Edge Cases: Network error shows icon+message; empty query shows seeds

User Story: As a listener I want to pick iTunes or PodcastIndex
Expected Behaviour: Provider persisted; only shown when multiple configured

User Story: As a listener I want offline playback
Expected Behaviour: Download shows 0-100% progress; file stored; cancel/pause supported
Edge Cases: Network failure pauses; storage permission; delete-while-playing stops audio

User Story: As a listener I want to see downloaded episodes
Expected Behaviour: fetchDownloads emits Loading then populated list; delete removes + refreshes
Edge Cases: Empty set -> empty populated list; delete currently-playing stops audio

User Story: As a listener I want to control playback
Expected Behaviour: Play/pause toggles; state streamed; disabled while buffering

User Story: As a listener I want to seek by fixed steps
Expected Behaviour: Seeks ±; clamps to [0

User Story: As a listener I want to change speed
Expected Behaviour: 0.5x-2.0x; persisted

User Story: As a listener I want to scrub
Expected Behaviour: Scrub to any position; shows elapsed/remaining
Edge Cases: Unknown duration disables slider; drag lock

User Story: As a listener I want a compact persistent player
Expected Behaviour: Shows artwork/title/play; tap opens full player; hides when stopped/error

User Story: As a listener I want a full-screen player
Expected Behaviour: Full player with artwork/notes/controls/tabs; responsive >1000px split
Edge Cases: Auto-close on episode end; playback error caught

User Story: As a listener I want chapter navigation
Expected Behaviour: Lists toc chapters; auto-scroll to current; tap to jump
Edge Cases: Empty chapters; toc=false hidden; loading state; numbering
Notes: Entity + selector UI (toc filter/loading/numbering) covered this iteration

User Story: As a listener I want to read/follow a transcript
Expected Behaviour: Shows transcript w/ speakers; auto-scroll to current subtitle; manual scroll disables auto
Edge Cases: Ad segments filtered; empty transcript; search; leave-tab-mid-scroll

User Story: As a listener I want ads detected automatically
Expected Behaviour: Local/cloud analysis produces ad segments; background task on Android
Edge Cases: Analysis completes after play start; disabled = no segments

User Story: As a listener I want a prompt before an ad is skipped
Expected Behaviour: Ambient card rises with countdown ring; auto-skip at 0; Skip/Keep buttons
Edge Cases: Countdown 0 = wait for manual; re-prompt cancels old timer; cleared state dismisses

User Story: As a listener I want skipped time tracked
Expected Behaviour: On skip the saved-seconds/count totals accumulate
Edge Cases: Zero-length segment is no-op; sub-second rounds

Feature Name: AI ad-skip settings + live hero stat
User Story: As a listener I want to configure ad-skip and see lifetime savings
Expected Behaviour: Toggle auto-skip/countdown/host-read/notify; hero stat shows live saved time/count
Edge Cases: Stat must update within session not only after restart
Notes: DEFECT D-001 fixed this iteration (stale hero stat)

User Story: As a listener I want a play queue
Expected Behaviour: Shows playing + reorderable up-next; empty state

Feature Name: Play next / Add to up next
User Story: As a listener I want to insert episodes at front or end
Expected Behaviour: position=0 inserts at front of up-next; null appends

User Story: As a listener I want to reorder up-next
Expected Behaviour: Drag reorders; persists; moveUpNextEpisode returns success
Notes: DEFECT D-002 fixed (move always returned false)

User Story: As a listener I want to filter/sort episodes
Expected Behaviour: Filter None/Played/Unplayed/Started; sort variants; persists per podcast

User Story: As a listener I want to mark an episode played
Expected Behaviour: Toggles played; updates tile; persists

User Story: As a listener I want quick actions per episode
Expected Behaviour: Sheet offers play/queue/download/share/mark + ads-ahead badge

User Story: As a listener I want playback to stop after a time
Expected Behaviour: Stops after duration or end-of-episode
Edge Cases: None default; zero duration; equality by type+duration; timeRemaining
Notes: Sleep entity logic covered; ticker/stop path manual

User Story: As a listener I want light/dark/system theme
Expected Behaviour: Persists; applies live

User Story: As a listener I want layout + sort options
Expected Behaviour: List/grid modes; sort orders; toggles badges; persists

User Story: As a listener I want feeds refreshed automatically
Expected Behaviour: Never..Always; drives background task

User Story: As a listener I want on-device ad analysis
Expected Behaviour: Enable/disable; download Gemma w/ HF token; progress/cancel
Edge Cases: Token read errors; stream errors; re-download confirm

User Story: As a listener I want to pick a transcription backend
Expected Behaviour: Local/OpenAI/Backend selectable

User Story: As a listener I want to import subscriptions
Expected Behaviour: Import file; per-podcast progress; subscribes

User Story: As a listener I want to export subscriptions
